svg.title: 考点 8-16 · 补充：wish / if only / would rather / it's time 的虚拟表达

g.title: G
g.text: 考点 8-16 · 补充：wish / if only / would rather / it's time 的虚拟表达

g.title: n0
g.text: wish if only 等虚拟

g.title: n2
g.text: 说明

g.title: n6
g.text: 规则

g.title: n19
g.text: 判断方法

g.title: n22
g.text: 易错点

g.title: n3
g.text: 底稿未将这些单列

g.title: n4
g.text: 与特殊句型 虚拟语气关联紧密

g.title: n5
g.text: 作为系统补充一并复习

g.title: n7
g.text: wish + 过去式或 were\n对现在的非真实愿望

g.title: n8
g.text: 补充例句 I wish I knew the answer

g.title: n9
g.text: wish + had done 对过去的遗憾

g.title: n10
g.text: 补充例句 I wish I had studied harder

g.title: n11
g.text: wish + would do\n希望未来情况或他人行为改变

g.title: n12
g.text: 补充例句 I wish he would stop shouting

g.title: n13
g.text: if only 要是……就好了

g.title: n14
g.text: 补充例句 If only I had more time

g.title: n15
g.text: would rather that + 主语 + 过去式\n对现在或未来的偏好

g.title: n16
g.text: 补充例句 I would rather you stayed\nhere

g.title: n17
g.text: It is high time + 主语 + 过去式

g.title: n18
g.text: 补充例句 It is time we left

g.title: n20
g.text: 这些结构的过去式可能不是实际过去时

g.title: n21
g.text: 而是在表达与现实有距离的愿望或建议

g.title: n23
g.text: would rather do 后接动词原形 I would\nrather stay

g.title: n24
g.text: 与 would rather that sb did\n是两个不同句式
